task: ae.rope: persistent AVL-balanced rope with line index, KMP search and invariant checker
reasoning_summary: Designed a persistent rope as an AVL tree of 32-char leaves with join/split as the only structural primitives, and cached length/newline/height per node. Wrote literal, differential (StringBuilder oracle with check() after every op), balance (100k appends/prepends), search and checker tests first; the first run failed only on three wrong hand-written expectations (LONG is 102 chars, not 100). A 20-mutant hand check killed 12, 5 were equivalent, and the one real gap (checker could not fail) got corrupt-tree tests.
